aggregation: equal-weight macro-average over predeclared workload-family and cluster strata within each seed
confidence_interval: two-sided 95% Student-t interval over 10 seed-block macro-averages (df=9)
multiple_comparisons: family-level intervals are exploratory and are not adjusted for multiple comparisons
p95_aggregation: macro-average of per-run nearest-rank drained-job P95 values; jobs are not pooled across runs
